title: Branch Reconditioning Labor on Returned Self-Pay PAP Therapy Equipment
content:
# Branch Reconditioning Labor on Returned Self-Pay PAP Therapy Equipment

When a self-pay PAP Therapy Equipment device bought outright comes back to Summit Ridge on a completed return pickup request, the branch books reconditioning labor for the unit on its return inspection, in 15-minute labor units.

## What this governs

- **Subject:** the reconditioning labor of a returned self-pay unit.
- **Result:** the number of labor units booked on the unit's return inspection, a whole number of 15-minute units.
- **Where it is booked:** on the return inspection filed on the returned unit's PAP Therapy Equipment device record by the agent; the inspection then appears in the device's service history, dated the day it is filed, showing the labor units booked.

## Desk questions

**Which units does this concern?** A self-pay PAP Therapy Equipment device bought outright that has come back to Summit Ridge on a completed return pickup request.

**Is labor recorded in hours?** No. It is recorded in 15-minute labor units, as a whole number.
